title: Featured Projects
subtitle: Backend-focused projects demonstrating expertise in APIs, microservices, and cloud infrastructure

cloudStorage.title: Cloud Storage Platform
cloudStorage.description: Full-featured cloud storage with chunked uploads, real-time sync, and sharing. Backend built with Node.js/Express, PostgreSQL for metadata, and AWS S3 for file storage. Dockerized deployment.

taskManager.title: Enterprise Task Manager API
taskManager.description: High-performance task management backend with FastAPI. Features include RBAC, WebSocket notifications, Redis caching, and async task processing with Celery.

uptime.title: Uptime Monitoring Service
uptime.description: Distributed monitoring system built with Node.js microservices. Uses MongoDB for metrics, Redis for job queues, and WebSockets for real-time alerts. Deployed on AWS ECS.

restaurant.title: AI-Powered Restaurant BaaS
restaurant.description: Backend-as-a-Service platform for restaurant management. Django REST API with AI chatbot integration, Stripe payments, and multi-tenant architecture.
